Word Garden lesson audio

Voice: Joe — US English male synthetic speech (en_US-joe-medium).
These are computer-generated recordings, not a human performance of the lessons.

Generated locally using Piper 1.8.0:
https://github.com/OHF-Voice/piper1-gpl
The Piper program and model are not included in this web app.

Voice model and model card:
https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices/tree/5041a7a49ae5b3a0f30e6837769eb03fdbb231bd/en/en_US/joe/medium
Model SHA-256: 58afce0321b8d9c46d7cdf9c16500cc55a793b4220212dba6b70fb788b3baf06

Original voice dataset: Nabu Casa / Open Home Foundation voice datasets,
en_US/joe. Dataset license: CC0 (public domain dedication).
https://github.com/OHF-Voice/voice-datasets
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

The Piper voice collection metadata lists MIT; the Joe model card separately
identifies its dataset as CC0. No Apple system voice recordings or paid speech
API was used. Naming the contributor identifies the synthetic voice source and
does not imply endorsement of Word Garden.

AAC-LC mono, 64 kbps. 50 lessons per track; use translation-audio.json for cues.
